input.rationale: Section 12 is materially one-sided: Client gives a very broad indemnity (breach, System/Credit Repository defaults, Web Site and Client Content, and product/service injury claims), while TrueLink's indemnity in 12(b)/p0075 is limited to claims arising from its own breach of the Agreement or failure to perform. There is no vendor IP indemnity anywhere in the document — no non-infringement warranty either (the only infringement references, p0024, p0041 and p0055, run against Client) — so the clause fails even the fallback position, which requires a Vendor IP indemnity. We therefore added IP infringement, breach of law, Vendor-caused data breach and gross negligence/wilful misconduct prongs to TrueLink's existing indemnity, which is the smallest edit reaching the preferred position. We have not disturbed the Section 12 liability cap (which by its terms covers Sections 3, 4, 7 and 11 only), and customary IP exclusions/remedies remain available as a fallback trade.

ops.oldText: claim arising out of any breach by TrueLink of this Agreement or any failure by TrueLink in the performance of any of its obligations or agreements hereunder.
ops.newText: claim arising out of (i) any breach by TrueLink of this Agreement or any failure by TrueLink in the performance of any of its obligations or agreements hereunder; (ii) any allegation that the Interface, the Hosting Services, the Support Services or any other materials or deliverables provided by TrueLink infringe or misappropriate any patent, copyright, trademark, trade secret or other intellectual property right; (iii) TrueLink's breach of any applicable law, rule or regulation; (iv) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Client Content or other Client data caused by TrueLink; or (v) TrueLink's gross negligence or willful misconduct.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We expanded TrueLink's indemnity to cover third-party IP infringement claims relating to the Interface and Services, plus TrueLink's breach of law, Client-data breaches it causes, and its gross negligence or willful misconduct, since as drafted only Client gives a broad indemnity and TrueLink stands behind nothing on IP. Our playbook requires a vendor IP indemnity; we can discuss customary exclusions (Client modifications, combinations and specifications) and procure/modify/replace/refund remedies.
proposal.summary: Add IP infringement, breach of law, data breach and misconduct prongs to TrueLink's indemnity in Section 12(b).
